ad_info.reference_style: Photorealistic before/after split-screen supplement ad with hero bottle, benefit cards and offer bar
ad_info.angle_used: Transformación / resultado — months of squats with no change vs. a routine with the support it was missing
ad_info.ad_format: Collage Ad (before/after split screen + product hero + benefit row + offer bar)

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F, deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, deep wine #4A0B2E, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent words, replaces the reference yellow), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (price pill), white #FFFFFF. Same contrast logic as the reference: dark header left, bright header right, dark glowing bottom panels, bright accent on key words and price.
global_identity.visual_style: Photorealistic before/after split screen of the same woman seen from behind, solid color header bands, large real bottle as hero on the center line, dark wine benefit panel with four neon-outlined cards and a rounded offer bar.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Aspirational, feminine, confident; flat neutral daylight on the 'before' side, warm golden-hour glow on the 'after' side, soft neon fuchsia glow on the bottom panels.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat color header blocks, thin white center divider, rounded-rectangle cards with glowing fuchsia outlines and white thin-line icons, round registration seal, fully rounded offer pill with burst lines and a glossy inner price pill.
global_identity.text_typography: Exactly the reference typography: heavy rounded geometric sans-serif (Nunito Black / Gotham Rounded Bold look) for all text. 'ANTES' and 'DESPUÉS' huge, all uppercase, white, centered. Header subtitles bold, sentence case, white, centered, two lines, about 45% of the header word height. Benefit labels bold all uppercase, white, centered, 2-3 lines. Offer bar: 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO' heavy uppercase white; 'X3 UNIDADES' heavier and about 1.4x larger, uppercase, bubblegum pink; price in the heaviest weight, the largest text of the bottom area, deep magenta inside a pale pink pill.

creative_objective: Recreate the user's winning before/after ad exactly, with the user's own bottle, and change only the two header subtitles to hit the gym pain: months of squats with no visible change, and the product as the daily support her routine was missing.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) 'ANTES' / 'DESPUÉS' headers and the before/after photos; 2) the large bottle on the center line; 3) the header subtitles; 4) the four benefit cards; 5) the offer bar with the price.
art_direction.composition_style: Strict symmetrical split: two equal columns for headers and photos, bottle centered on the divider, full-width benefit row and offer bar below.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Header band 0-12.5% of height; photos 12.5-68%; benefit panel 68-87% with four equal cards and small even gutters; offer bar 88-98% with small side margins.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Before photo flat cool daylight; after photo warm sunset backlight with rim light on skin; bottle with soft studio light and a soft contact shadow; neon fuchsia outer glow on cards and offer bar.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top band split in two: left dark plum block with 'ANTES' and a two-line subtitle, right hot fuchsia block with 'DESPUÉS' and a two-line subtitle. Below, two 50/50 photos of the same woman from behind: left in a bright bedroom wearing a white t-shirt knotted at the back and gray bike shorts; right on a beach at sunset in a bikini. A large bottle stands centered on the vertical divider, overlapping both photos, its base touching the top of the benefit panel; a round registration seal overlaps its lower-right side. Bottom: dark wine panel with four rounded cards (icon + uppercase label). Footer: wide rounded offer bar with 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO' / 'X3 UNIDADES' on the left, a thin vertical divider and the price inside a pill on the right.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 photorealistic before/after split-screen supplement ad, recreating this exact layout. TOP HEADER BAND (top 12.5% of the canvas), split into two equal halves: the left half is a solid dark plum (#2B1226) block with the huge white heavy rounded uppercase word 'ANTES' centered and, under it, a centered two-line bold white subtitle; the right half is a solid hot fuchsia (#E6177F) block with the huge white word 'DESPUÉS' centered and its centered two-line bold white subtitle. A thin white vertical line divides the canvas in two from the top band down to the benefit panel. PHOTO AREA (12.5% to 68% of the height), two equal photos side by side: LEFT 'before' photo — a Latina woman about 27 years old with long wavy dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, seen from behind from the head to mid-thigh, standing in a bright neutral bedroom with a white-sheeted bed and a wooden headboard, wearing a loose white t-shirt knotted at the lower back and gray cotton bike shorts, flat cool daylight, slightly muted colors, natural slim figure with flat hips. RIGHT 'after' photo — the same woman, same hair and same rear framing, standing on a Caribbean beach at golden-hour sunset with turquoise sea and palm silhouettes, wearing a hot-pink bikini, warm glowing backlight, toned legs and a fuller, rounder, lifted figure that looks natural and realistic, not exaggerated. HERO PRODUCT: the attached product bottle, large, front-facing and perfectly sharp, standing centered exactly on the vertical dividing line, from about 20% to 68% of the canvas height, overlapping both photos, its base resting on the top edge of the benefit panel, soft studio light and a soft shadow. Product: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh underline, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace, relabel or reinterpret it, and do not add any badge to it. REGISTRATION SEAL: a round white seal with a thin metallic fuchsia rim overlapping the lower-right side of the bottle (about 10% of the canvas width), with 'REGISTRO SANITARIO' curved along the top arc, 'INVIMA' in bold deep magenta in the center and 'RSA-0030271-2024' curved along the bottom arc. BENEFIT PANEL (68% to 87% of the height): deep wine background (#4A0B2E fading to #2B1226) with a soft fuchsia glow, holding four equal rounded-rectangle cards side by side with small even gutters; each card has a dark magenta fill, a glowing neon fuchsia outline, a white thin-line icon in the upper half and a bold white uppercase centered label below. Card 1: icon of a female waist silhouette with a circular arrow and a small check badge. Card 2: icon of an open hand holding a package with small motion lines. Card 3: icon of three ascending bars. Card 4: icon of a shield with a check mark. OFFER BAR (88% to 98% of the height): one wide, fully rounded pill bar across nearly the full width, deep magenta-to-wine gradient fill with a thin glowing fuchsia border; on its left part two stacked lines of text, the second line larger, flanked by three short bubblegum-pink burst lines on each side; a thin white vertical divider; on its right part a glossy pale blush pink (#FBE3EE) inner pill holding the price in huge heavy deep magenta (#B0105E) numerals. Typography for all text: heavy rounded geometric sans-serif (Nunito Black / Gotham Rounded Bold look), crisp and perfectly legible on a phone. Write every text exactly as listed in the text layers, each once, in its position. Do not add logos, CTA buttons, stars, testimonials, old prices or any element not described here.
